```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a violin plot to show the distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='is_fraud', y='amount', data=data, palette='muted', scale='area')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Is Fraud (0 = No, 1 = Yes)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
